question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH leg_first AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, 
           MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start,
           lt.state as first_state
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN (
        SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as min_start
        FROM legislators_terms
        GROUP BY id_bioguide
    ) m ON lt.id_bioguide = m.id_bioguide AND lt.term_start = m.min_start
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, lt.state
),
leg_with_gender AS (
    SELECT lf.id_bioguide, lf.first_term_start, lf.first_state, l.gender
    FROM leg_first lf
    JOIN legislators l ON lf.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
),
time_points AS (
    SELECT 0 as year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT lwg.id_bioguide, lwg.gender, lwg.first_state, tp.year_offset,
           (lwg.first_term_start::DATE + (tp.year_offset || ' years')::INTERVAL) as interval_date,
           (DATE_TRUNC('year', lwg.first_term_start::DATE + (tp.year_offset || ' years')::INTERVAL) + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day') as dec31_date
    FROM leg_with_gender lwg
    CROSS JOIN time_points tp
),
retained AS (
    SELECT rc.id_bioguide, rc.gender, rc.first_state, rc.year_offset,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
               WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = rc.id_bioguide
               AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= rc.dec31_date
               AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= rc.dec31_date
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_retained
    FROM retention_check rc
),
state_retention AS (
    SELECT first_state, gender, year_offset, 
           COUNT(*) as total,
           SUM(is_retained) as retained_count,
           1.0 * SUM(is_retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retained
    GROUP BY first_state, gender, year_offset
),
gender_state_check AS (
    SELECT first_state, gender,
           MIN(retention_rate) as min_retention,
           COUNT(*) as num_time_points_with_data,
           SUM(CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_positive
    FROM state_retention
    GROUP BY first_state, gender
),
valid_states AS (
    SELECT first_state
    FROM gender_state_check
    GROUP BY first_state
    HAVING MIN(num_positive) >= 6
       AND MIN(num_time_points_with_data) >= 6
)

FROM valid_states
ORDER BY first_state
